scripts._comment_release_prod: Prod release regression: full non-real-order suite PLUS exactly the 2 @prod-order specs (order-loggedin-cart-cc + order-loggedin-checkout-cc), skips every other @real-order test. One command for release day, no separate real-order run needed. NOTE: order-loggedin-checkout-cc is EXPECTED RED on prod (Cloudflare Turnstile blocks automated /checkout submit there, confirmed 2026-07-01 — not a bug, not flaky); order-loggedin-cart-cc is the real prod order-coverage path and should pass. BRAND defaults to drmarty; override with BRAND=badlands.
scripts.cartv3:release:prod: BRAND=${BRAND:-drmarty} ENVIRONMENT=prod npx playwright test tests --grep-invert "@real-order" && BRAND=${BRAND:-drmarty} ENVIRONMENT=prod npx playwright test tests --grep "@prod-order"

scripts._comment_subscription: Subscription-management specs (/subscription-edit). The skip/next-date/quantity/ship-now specs self-heal an existing sub (no order placed) so they run UAT + prod. cancel is @real-order + UAT-only (it places a real subscription order). 'all:uat' includes cancel; 'all:prod' runs the 4 self-heal specs (cancel auto-skips on prod). ship-now places an HQ-suppressed order on prod — see its spec header.

scripts._comment_rerun_failures: Reruns the read-only specs that failed in the last triage run (cart pricing-after-login, paypal button, shipping threshold, verify-fields-and-links, verify-header-links; checkout subscription-terms; header; order list-reorder). subscription-ship-now is deliberately EXCLUDED — it places a real order and is being reworked on another branch. NOTE: header + cart-verify-header-links can fail on a VWO A/B variant that changes the header link markup (variant-dependent, not our selector). Defaults headless — prefix HEADED=1 to watch. Swap ENVIRONMENT=prod for prod.
